mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO adi_document_graph_vertex (kb_uuid, doc_uuid, segment_uuid, name, entity_type, description) VALUES
(#{r.kbUuid}, #{r.docUuid}, #{r.segmentUuid}, #{r.name}, #{r.entityType}, #{r.description})
ON CONFLICT (kb_uuid, name, segment_uuid) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT v1.name AS name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.segment_uuid) FROM adi_document_graph_vertex v2 WHERE v2.kb_uuid = v1.kb_uuid AND v2.name = v1.name AND v2.segment_uuid != v1.segment_uuid) AS otherContributors FROM adi_document_graph_vertex v1 WHERE v1.segment_uuid = #{segmentUuid}

SELECT v1.name AS name, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v2.segment_uuid) FROM adi_document_graph_vertex v2 WHERE v2.kb_uuid = v1.kb_uuid AND v2.name = v1.name AND v2.doc_uuid != v1.doc_uuid) AS otherContributors FROM adi_document_graph_vertex v1 WHERE v1.doc_uuid = #{docUuid}
SELECT name AS name, string_agg(COALESCE(description, ''), chr(10) ORDER BY id) AS description FROM adi_document_graph_vertex WHERE doc_uuid = #{docUuid} GROUP BY name ORDER BY name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM adi_document_graph_vertex WHERE doc_uuid = #{docUuid}
